title: texanshootR
text: Entry point: shoot() R/shoot.R. Everything else either feeds runs run object returns. R/shoot.R — main loop: budget, spec cap, mini-batched fits, mascot transitions, output-flag dispatch. R/shoot_search.R — spec queue / perturbation seeding / bias resolution. R/shoot_engine.R — fit_specs_batch C++ bridge. R/shoot_derived.R — desperation-phase derived metrics. R/families.R + R/family_select.R — model family pickers per outcome type. R/ui.R — TUI session manager. Three rendering modes (see ). R/mascot.R — emotional state ladder, heartbeat frames, cell-width tables. R/modifiers_live.R — pre-roll vs interactive tactical-pause modifiers. R/chain.R — publication chain state machine (XP, length unlocked, active chain, window expiry). R/output_*.R — six generators (abstract, manuscript, presentation, reviewer_response, graphical_abstract, funding), gated chain stage. R/output_helpers.R — OUTPUT_GENERATORS registry + generate_flagged_outputs() auto-generation shoot() flags. R/career.R + R/unlocks.R + R/achievements.R + R/wardrobe.R — progression / cosmetic surface. R/run.R — print.tx_run() narrative banner. R/terminal_spawn.R — Windows Terminal / cmd.exe spawn terminal=TRUE. R/messages.R + R/message_select.R — message bank loader + validator (lints loading-phase text DYN_LOADING_BUDGET). R/save_io.R + R/save_migrate.R — -disk meta (career, XP, achievements, active chain) texanshootR.save_dir. inst/messages/*.yaml — registry files. loading_general.yaml big one (~140KB).
